evals.prompt: Build a results framework for our NASA soil-moisture drought tool for state ag extension.
expectations: Produces Impact / Outcome long / Outcome short / Output / Input table
Every outcome is a behavior or decision change by a user type
Assumption record has monitor and action-if-fails per link

evals.prompt: Help us write an if/then statement for a hail damage insurance product.
expectations: Uses 'If we ___, then users will ___, then ___ will improve.' form

evals.prompt: Results framework please, outcome: 'a dashboard is delivered'.
expectations: Pushes back that a delivered dashboard is an output, not an outcome

evals.prompt: Write a one-page status brief for our partner.
expectations: Skill is NOT triggered (belongs to partner-status-brief)
